plain_text: To change the paper size in Word, go to Layout in the top ribbon and open the Page Setup dialog box.
semantic_text: To change the paper size in Word, go to Layout in the top ribbon and open the Page Setup dialog box.

plain_text: From the "Paper" tab of the Page Setup dialog box, you can specify a page size up to 22" x 22".
semantic_text: From the "Paper" tab of the Page Setup dialog box, you can specify a page size up to 22" x 22".

plain_text:
For Inserts that consist only of text, insert an image file OR paste in a text file. The template will
automatically expand to accommodate multiple pages of pasted text.
semantic_text: For Inserts that consist only of text, insert an image file OR paste in a text file. The template will automatically expand to accommodate multiple pages of pasted text.

plain_text:
To change the paper size cannot be changed using Adobe Reader. After conversion to a PDF file, Acrobat
PRO software (or equivalent) must be used to change the paper size after conversion to a PDF file. See
the appendix at the end of this guide titled,
"Instructions for Scaling Pages in Adobe Acrobat PRO"
.

plain_text:
If the page size cannot be increased
enough to fit the image at 100%
magnification, it is permissible to
resize the image to less than 100%
magnification, provided that the
actual magnification is stated on
the mounting sheet.
semantic_text: If the page size cannot be increased enough to fit the image at 100% magnification, it is permissible to resize the image to less than 100% magnification, provided that the actual magnification is stated on the mounting sheet.
